packages.name: libc6
packages.description:
Contains the standard libraries that are used by nearly all programs on
the system. This package includes shared versions of the standard C library
and the standard math library, as well as many others.

packages.name: libsqlite3-0
packages.copyrightText:
D. Richard Hipp <drh@hwaci.com>
2006-     Laszlo Boszormenyi (GCS) <gcs@debian.org>,
2005-2006 Tomas Fasth <tomfa@debian.org>,
2001-2005 Andreas Rottmann <rotty@debian.org>

D. Richard Hipp <drh@hwaci.com>
2006-     Laszlo Boszormenyi (GCS) <gcs@debian.org>
Jan Palus <atler@pld-linux.org>
packages.description:
SQLite is a C library that implements an SQL database engine.
Programs that link with the SQLite library can have SQL database
access without running a separate RDBMS process.

packages.name: libssl3t64
packages.copyrightText:
1995-2020, The OpenSSL Project Authors
Christoph Martin, Kurt Roeckx, Sebastian Andrzej Siewior
2013, Mark Jason Dominus <mjd@cpan.org>.
packages.summary: Secure Sockets Layer toolkit - shared libraries
packages.description:
This package is part of the OpenSSL project's implementation of the SSL
and TLS cryptographic protocols for secure communication over the
Internet.

It provides the libssl and libcrypto shared libraries.

packages.name: zlib1g
packages.copyrightText:
1995-2013 Jean-loup Gailly and Mark Adler
1998 by Andreas R. Kleinert
1998-2010 Gilles Vollant
2007-2008 Even Rouault
2009-2010 Mathias Svensson
2000-2017 Mark Brown
packages.licenseComments:
This is the pre-packaged Debian Linux version of the zlib compression
library.  It was packaged by Michael Alan Dorman <mdorman@debian.org>
from sources originally retrieved from ftp.uu.net in the directory
/pub/archiving/zip/zlib as the file zlib-1.0.4.tar.gz.

The deflate format used by zlib was defined by Phil Katz. The deflate
and zlib specifications were written by Peter Deutsch. Thanks to all the
people who reported problems and suggested various improvements in zlib;
they are too numerous to cite here.
packages.description:
zlib is a library implementing the deflate compression method found
in gzip and PKZIP.  This package includes the shared library.
